tools.name: search_kb
tools.description: Look up general Copperline information: hours, the routing number, legacy names (Marklin Steel Employees FCU, Copperline Federal, Granford Credit Union), the ID-theft recovery partner, membership basics, how disputes work. Call it before saying you do not know something. Matching is tolerant; pass the caller's own words.

query.description: What the caller wants to know, in a few words.

tools.name: get_branch_info
tools.description: Address, hours, and services for one branch. Pass the town or branch name the caller said; matching is tolerant. Branches: Averton (headquarters), Granford, Marklin Crossing, Harrow Mills, Danbrook, Pell Creek.

branch.description: Town or branch name as the caller said it.

tools.name: get_fee
tools.description: The published fee schedule. Pass the fee the caller asked about in their own words ("overdraft fee", "wire", "stop payment", "replacement card") — aliases are mapped. Returns the exact amount and its conditions. Never state a fee amount you did not get from this tool or from a quote.

fee.description: The fee the caller asked about, in their words.

tools.name: check_membership_eligibility
tools.description: Whether someone can join Copperline under the 2026 multiple-common-bond charter. Pass the Pennsylvania county they live or work in, and their employer if they mentioned one.

county.description: County of residence or work, as said.

employer.description: Employer, if the caller mentioned one; empty otherwise.

tools.name: identify_member
tools.description: Find the member record from full name plus phone number. Call it as soon as you have both, before verification. It discloses nothing about the account — it only tells you whether there is a record to verify against. Matching is tolerant of small mispronunciations and accepts the last four digits of the phone.

phone.description: Ten-digit phone number, or its last four digits.

tools.name: verify_identity
tools.description: Verify the identified caller with date of birth plus the last four of their member number. Both must match the record found by identify_member. Success unlocks account data for the rest of this call. After two failures, stop and escalate with reason identity_failed. A caller who is not the member on the record can never verify — do not coach them.

member_number_last4.description: Last four digits of the member number.

tools.name: get_member_summary
tools.description: The verified member's relationship at a glance: each account with its type and last four digits, cards on file, loans, and member-since year. Requires verification. Never read more than the last four digits of anything.

tools.name: get_balance
tools.description: Current and available balance for one account. Pass the account as the caller referred to it ("my checking", "savings", last four digits) — matching is tolerant. Requires verification.

account.description: Account reference: type or last four digits, as the caller said it.

tools.name: get_transactions
tools.description: Recent transactions for one account, newest first. Optionally limit to on-or-after a date. Use it for "did X clear", to find a fee, or to locate a transaction the caller wants to dispute. Requires verification.

account.description: Account reference: type or last four digits.

since.description: Optional ISO date YYYY-MM-DD; empty for the recent history.

tools.name: explain_fee
tools.description: Explain one fee transaction: what it is, the transaction that triggered it, and — for overdraft fees — whether the purchase was authorized on a sufficient balance and settled negative. Pass the transaction id from get_transactions. Requires verification.

transaction_id.description: The fee transaction's id from get_transactions.

tools.name: request_fee_reversal
tools.description: Ask the system to reverse a fee. The decision is the system's: a member's first Courtesy Pay fee in twelve months reverses automatically; anything else returns NOT_AUTO_REVERSIBLE with the script to read. Never promise a reversal before calling this. Requires verification.

transaction_id.description: The fee transaction's id from get_transactions.

tools.name: check_waiver_status
tools.description: Whether this account's monthly maintenance fee is currently waived, and exactly which waiver condition is met or missed, with the member's actual numbers against the thresholds. Requires verification.

account.description: Account reference: type or last four digits.

tools.name: quote_internal_transfer
tools.description: Step one of a transfer between the member's own Copperline accounts. Prices the transfer — including the $25 excess-withdrawal fee when the source is a High Yield Savings past three withdrawals this quarter — and returns a summary to read back plus a confirmation token. Moves nothing. Requires verification.

from_account.description: Source account: type or last four digits.

to_account.description: Destination account: type or last four digits.

tools.name: confirm_internal_transfer
tools.description: Step two: execute the transfer quoted by quote_internal_transfer, after the member has heard the summary — including any fee — and agreed. Pass the token from the quote.

tools.name: quote_wire
tools.description: Step one of an outgoing wire. Returns the fee for the tier ($15 domestic under $2,500, $30 domestic at $2,500 or more, $50 foreign), a fraud warning that must be read to the member word for word, and a confirmation token. Sends nothing. Requires verification.

beneficiary.description: Who the wire is going to, as the member described them.

tools.name: confirm_wire
tools.description: Step two: send the wire quoted by quote_wire. Requires the token and fraud_warning_acknowledged: true, which you may only set after reading the warning and hearing the member confirm they still want to send it. Wires are final once sent.

fraud_warning_acknowledged.description: True only after the fraud warning was read aloud and the member confirmed.

tools.name: quote_stop_payment
tools.description: Step one of a stop payment on a check. Returns the fee for this member's account type ($25, or $0 on Cashback Rewards Checking), a summary, and a confirmation token. Requires verification.

account.description: Account the check draws on: type or last four digits.

check_number.description: The check number, as the member read it.

tools.name: confirm_stop_payment
tools.description: Step two: place the stop payment quoted by quote_stop_payment, after the member has heard the fee and agreed. Pass the token from the quote.

tools.name: quote_loan_payment
tools.description: Step one of a loan payment by phone. Returns the payment summary with the convenience fee for the method — $2.75 by eCheck, $5.50 by debit card — and a confirmation token. Offer the cheaper method. Requires verification.

loan.description: Loan reference: type or last four digits.

tools.name: confirm_loan_payment
tools.description: Step two: post the loan payment quoted by quote_loan_payment, after the member has heard the amount and convenience fee and agreed. Pass the token from the quote.

tools.name: get_cards
tools.description: The verified member's cards: type, last four digits, and status. Call it before any card action so you act on the right card. Requires verification.

tools.name: block_card
tools.description: Block a card immediately. One step, no confirmation ceremony — blocking is protective and reversible by the member in the app. Call it the moment a member reports a card lost or stolen, before anything else. Requires verification.

card_last4.description: Last four digits of the card, from get_cards.

tools.name: quote_card_replacement
tools.description: Step one of ordering a replacement card. Returns the fee — $10, free when the card was stolen — plus $30 for expedited domestic or $35 for expedited international delivery, a summary, and a confirmation token. Requires verification.

card_last4.description: Last four digits of the card being replaced.

tools.name: confirm_card_replacement
tools.description: Step two: order the replacement quoted by quote_card_replacement, after the member has heard the fee and delivery time and agreed. Pass the token from the quote.

tools.name: set_travel_notice
tools.description: Put a travel notice on the member's cards so legitimate charges are not declined. One step. Requires verification.

destinations.description: Where they are travelling, as said.

tools.name: file_dispute
tools.description: File a dispute on a transaction. The first call returns DISCLOSURE_REQUIRED with the exact federal script for this claim type — Reg E for debit, Reg Z for credit cards — including the clocks and, for debit, provisional credit. Read it word for word, then call again with disclosures_acknowledged: true to file. A dispute is never refused, even outside the 60-day window; the window status comes back with the claim. Requires verification.

transaction_id.description: The disputed transaction's id from get_transactions.

disclosures_acknowledged.description: True only after the returned disclosure script was read to the member.

tools.name: get_dispute_status
tools.description: Status of one of this member's existing dispute claims, including its clock. Requires verification.

claim_id.description: The claim id, or empty to list this member's claims.

tools.name: escalate_to_human
tools.description: Transfer to Copperline member care. Terminal: once called, do nothing else. Reason codes: identity_failed, not_authorized, fraud_in_progress, elder_exploitation, hardship, collections, investment_advice, dispute_appeal, business_services, caller_request, out_of_scope.

reason_code.description: One reason code from the list.

tools.name: transfer_to_identity
tools.description: Hand the caller to identity verification the moment they need anything account-bound: balances, transactions, cards, payments, disputes. Bridge in a few words; never announce a transfer.

tools.name: transfer_to_accounts
tools.description: Hand a verified member to account services: balances, transactions, fee explanations and reversals, monthly-fee waiver questions.

tools.name: transfer_to_payments
tools.description: Hand a verified member to payments: transfers between accounts, wires, stop payments, loan payments by phone.

tools.name: transfer_to_cards
tools.description: Hand a verified member to card services: lost or stolen cards, replacements, travel notices.

tools.name: transfer_to_disputes
tools.description: Hand a verified member to disputes: unauthorized transactions and billing errors on debit or credit.

tools.name: end_call
tools.description: End the call once everything the caller needs is done, or immediately for spam or a wrong number. Say goodbye first. Never end while you still owe the caller an answer, a confirmation, or a transfer.

reason.description: Why the call is ending, in a few words.
